description:
Activate Voice of the Blessed by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Voice of the Blessed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
